_doc: Inputs for the closing-runway planner (timing.py). Answers: given month-to-month rent with a landlord notice period and a target close window, when does a winning offer need to be in, and when do we give notice? Lead times (escrow, list->under-contract) are derived from comps.json; budget/price come from criteria.json. Override here only to force a value.
_notice_note: Landlord is month-to-month and asked for 2 months' heads-up before we leave.
_target_note: Want to close in 2026; it's already mid-year, so the live window is Aug-Dec. Edit months to re-plan.
_overlap_note: Acceptable lease+mortgage double-pay window. Escrow (~38d from comps) is shorter than the 60d notice, so giving notice at under-contract leaves ~3 wks of overlap past closing.
_lead_time_note: null = derive from comps.json. Set a number to override (e.g. if your lender quotes a firm escrow length).
